name: Pussyphus stage v3 · the air in the atrium
asked: it doesn't really have any shader or atmospheric effect on the scene as i had hoped. i think we need to widen the view port, and think about giving some more depth of field and even bigger scale to the mall. it's all very close and flat.
read: A vast glass-vaulted atrium seen from a cat's height: the air carries the light, the far mall dissolves into it, the sun comes through the vault in slanted sheets, and only Bo, on her step, is sharp.

view.display: 1 CSS px per stage pixel, image-rendering: pixelated

terraces.floors: two below the camera, three above, then a parapet

scale.ground: terrazzo with brass-ringed inlays, 8.4 m below the camera
scale.trees: five ficus rising 10-16 m from the ground floor, crowns around the escalator

sources.depth: view-space depth per stage pixel from the CPU ray cast (static scene, steps, figures, plants, Bo)
sources.emissive: alpha channel: lamps 255, neon 210, glints 150, lit sky 50, lit store interiors 70, warm lamp sprites 255
sources.sky_state: SKY.paint returns shaft (sun not behind a cloud, by weather and hour) and ambient; shaft is eased over about 2 s
sources.hour_weather: air density, air colour, sun colour, shadow and highlight tones

shared_causes.cause: the air (density by weather x hour, colour by hour)
drives: glow spread around lamps and neon
the length of the shaft march

shared_causes.cause: the vault's glazing (clear half of each truss bay, clear pane columns 2.8 m apart)
drives: sun patches on floors and walls (CPU)
dust motes, drawn only where sunlit

shared_causes.cause: the sky's clouds over the sun

pass_order.lane: CPU ray cast into a typed array, ramps + Bayer 4x4
pass_order.why: the pixel art itself; every surface keeps its ramp

pass_order.what: T = exp(-sigma * distance); colour = scene*T + air*(1-T); 14-sample march adds sun where the ray crosses lit air
pass_order.why: the air sits in the world, before the lens

pass_order.what: depth of field focused on Bo; far blur up to 1.7 px, near up to 3.2 px; 24-tap disc; focus moves only when she moves 0.3 m
pass_order.why: after the air, so the haze and the beams are blurred with what is behind them

pass_order.what: bright pass from the emissive channel at half resolution, separable blur whose reach grows with air density
pass_order.why: after the lens, so out-of-focus lamps glow wider

pass_order.what: exposure (0.92 day, 0.75 night), split tone from shadow toward highlight by hour
quantise to 64 levels a channel with the Bayer 4x4
pass_order.why: last, so the image keeps the pixel grain and the haze never bands

shaft.amount: 0.5 x sky shaft; x0.35 in rain, snow, mist; 0 at night

removal_test.air: the far mall and the bigger scale read close and flat again
removal_test.shafts: the vault stops putting light into the room; the skylight is only a picture above it
removal_test.lens: the focus on Bo goes and the depth hierarchy flattens
removal_test.glare: lamps and neon read as flat discs and bars, worst at night
removal_test.grade: dusk and night lose their temperature
removal_test.dither: the haze bands and the image stops reading as pixel art

refused: film grain (her ban on fat grain)
vignette (the composition already leads to Bo)

production.fallback: no WebGL2: the stage draws its CPU image directly, as in v2
production.reduced_motion: everything in the pass is static per frame; the focus never animates without Bo moving
production.known_change: with the pass on, output colours are no longer limited to the ramps; the ramps still shape every surface before the air
